tosu.exe goes here before building the packaged .exe.

It is NOT committed to this repo (LGPL-3.0 binary, plus git shouldn't carry
third-party executables). Two ways to get it:

1. Run `fetch_tosu.ps1` from the project root - downloads the latest
   Windows release straight from tosu's GitHub releases.
2. Or manually download from https://github.com/tosuapp/tosu/releases
   and drop `tosu.exe` in this folder.

See ../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for attribution and license details.
